themes.name: трекер помогает держаться трезвости
themes.nameEn: the tracker helps people stay sober

reviews.text: Stephen. Great app 🙂
Unskippable Ads for Gambling on an app for addicts ??. Horrible- can’t even use the app because of the ads. Oh well.
Ads!. Great app but having to close it to get rid of an absurd amount of ads is absolutely ridiculous. Probably a deal breaker for most people
Adds. Too many adds
Addicting Game Ad Platform. This is truly sick that you are running highly additive, unavoidable game ads on an app for people with addiction issues. Shame on you.

Worthless because of ads. So many ads you can’t actually do anything. Why? There’s no option to close out of the ads either so I’m just staring at a screen waiting for it to change and it won’t. Worthless

Good but app has issues. I like this app but some of the percentages are off. It’ll say I’m 60% of the way to a milestone that I’m actually 98% of the way too. App has weird glitches like that quite frequently
This app is a trigger!!. This app will cause u to drink bc of the ads and not able to get pass them!!

Not usable. I used this app in the past and just redownloaded it. You can’t do anything within the app without another ad popping up. Every time you try to move around in the app to look at new information you have to go through another ad. Every time! Even to just go to settings to adjust your information. 
I understand a few ads, but this is over the top bad, and it destroys the app’s purpose.

Literally an uncloseable ad for pressing any button. App is an absolute blight to use. Never in my LIFE have I gotten an ad that I CANNOT close for pressing the settings button. What a waste of space on the internet, devs should be absolutely ashamed

Please get rid of the ads!!!. On December 25, 2025 I will be four years sober. I am proud of myself. I was able to do it cold turkey, but for somebody who may have trouble quitting, putting ads on an app could discourage them and caused them to drink. I honestly think in an app that is used for sobriety. It should be nice and clean and with NO ADS. I think at the end of the day the ads on your app can cause someone to relapse.
Constant Ads. I couldn’t even get to anything good because anything I clicked on, there was a new game add, and it took so long to be able to leave the ad.
Junk - Do not download.. Developers lied when they responded previously that the ads are skippable after 6 seconds. A once decent app is total unusable garbage now.
Too many game ads!. Way too many game ads! You can’t even use the app. It used to be good.

Ad situation is now ridiculous. The ads are the type that force you to watch, for a long duration, with no option to skip or exit. This wasn’t always the case, but unfortunately, it makes the user experience very annoying now. The app is supposed to be helping people, not frustrating them.

Was good now, too many adds. After taking a hiatus from this app, I decided to reinstall it and now it’s barely usable. There are so many ads when you click on any button and it won’t let you out and redirect you to different game sites or whatever the ad is for it’s impossible to utilize so you have to keep deleting it and reinstalling it and then you get at least half a day of it acting normally, and then the ads pop up again. It used to be a really good app
Used to be good, now riddled with ads. Used to love this app, now it’s an ad every time you want to switch tabs and no way to get rid of the ad. Going to switch to another platform now.

Ads block usage. I have been using this app off and on for years. It always was awesome. There were ads here and there but I didn’t mind as they passed quickly and the app was really helpful. I downloaded it again a week ago and it’s pretty much unusable. Every time I open it and try to se my progress a Vagner app come on and stays there with no way to remove it for over five minutes. I get they need ads but this has made it impossible to use at all.

Could Use Something Better for Cutting Back. I appreciate the health stuff and all the rewards. However, it lets me set up to show how many per week to cut down to to get to my goal. But it basically only gives you the opportunity to show the last drink you took and everything reboots back… there’s no way to input and evaluate how many drinks during the week I’m drinking. For someone just looking to cut back, there should be some ways to see how those goals are being met…it’s prob much better for someone trying to quit altogether…
This was written by someone else and I 100% agree - I’ve been trying to figure out how to record how much I’m drinking and slowing down. There’s just a weekly countdown but no way to really apply that countdown unless you keep track elsewhere in which case - why bother with particular app.

Annoying ads. I deleted almost immediately because it had those full screen popup ads that you can’t close. No opinion on the quality of the ap itself because i barely started using it before the ad came on.
Too many apps. Before you can view a tab you have to watch an ad. I know it is free and I don’t mind some .

Great free app. The visual aide for quitting drinking is so helpful, makes the first steps in sobriety days easier and extra rewarding. Lots of ads and I wish you could get past them faster, but overall it’s great and free!
Too many ads. Used this app for years always had ads but now its out if hand I’ll just use a calendar old school
Couldn’t even get past the sign up page. Ad after ad that I couldn’t close. At least hook me first. Deleted it
Disappointed. I love this app, but was so disappointed to see ads were now added to it. I get excited to see my progress, but had to sit through two long ads to finally see it. Very frustrating!!
ADS. Ads every time you click on something.

Your ads are the worst. I love your app but in the last few months your ads have gotten sooooooo long! And anytime I switch from one section to another you have to watch them again. Many times after over 10 minutes of waiting, I restart my phone-that’s the only way to get back to the content. Looking for a new app.

Used to be great, too many ads now. It used to be great, now it’s constant ads.
The ads make me want a drink.

Really helpful app. This app was super helpful and fun at the beginning of my sobriety.
I really enjoyed looking at my health increase the more days I got sober. I highly recommend it to others to this day, but now I am really disappointed at how many ads I have to watch.

Used to be great. When I first quit drinking 3 years ago this was a lifesaver. I loved it. Throughout the last 3 years I kept coming back to it for encouragement when I needed it. 

But now, like everything else, it’s plagued with advertisements. You can’t switch tabs without getting a 30 second ad. I get it the people need money to keep it going but it kinda just ruined the whole thing for many people. A year ago I woulda gave it 5 stars, but now I’ll give it a four. And that’s being generous because SERIOUSLY the ads do ruin it. Like actually ruin it.

Ads. I get having to include ads for the free edition, but the ads were intrusive, long, and would always redirect to the app store. I hit settings and got an ad that wouldn't allow me to skip or exit from (even after 30 seconds). Avoid this app. Get the "Days Since" App instead.
What’s with all the ads!!!! I don’t wanna play any games. Every time I turn the app on, it jumps to some game that it wants me to play. I’m getting very frustrated.

Motivation. 2.5 years sober! This app was exactly what I needed. I loved seeing how my health was improving and it really kept me going. I stopped using the app after a year but wanted to come back and give it 5 stars. After 35 years of alcohol abuse, this app kept me motivated.
Too many ads. The main page is great but I couldn’t get beyond that with so many ads popping up. I deleted the app.
Don’t like the games. Don’t want any games!! Just my stats, with I can’t get cuz it always goes to games!!!
Great app, but…. Great app , and I get the need for ads, but they are so long. Unusable for me.

Great until the ads became ridiculous.. Maybe this was a bug, but most of the ads I got were not skippable after 5-10 seconds like the dev has replied to some comments. They would run incessantly, or generate another ad. I understand the need for ads I want the developer to generate some revenue after all but these became far too intrusive. I had to delete the app and that’s a shame because it was truly helpful.

It’s OK. I do enjoy this app! It’s nice to check out what you’re achieving as you navigate through sobriety!!! 

Would be much better without ads.
Too many ads. The amount of ads and length they play make this app practically unusable
Ads are a pain.. The app is making me watch an ad and then still won’t let me enter data, just goes into another ad.
Love the app, hate the ads. The app has so many ads.

Too many ADs. The app used to be free and now it has a bunch of glitchy ads. It’s pretty terrible that I don’t have access to my information easily. If you are looking for a sobriety app look into others that are ad free and ethical.

No Longer Good. I’ve had this app off and on, and it used to be great. Unfortunately the adds are awful now, I had to sit through 2 minutes of adds just to get to the settings tab. The X button was hidden so after a few seconds you could exit out, and it automatically forced a pop up to purchase the product they were promoting.
What happened. I loved this app but now it is nothing but advertisements. Like nothing. So bizarre
Me. Won’t let me access sobriety screen because of game ads. Terrible

JFC, the ads.. It’s incredibly poor taste to stuff online gambling ads into an app for people struggling with addiction. And these ads have so completely infested the app as to make it unusable. I don’t mind looking at an ad here and there, or paying for an ad free version. This current iteration has me watching two extensive ads for EVERY SINGLE click. Do better.
A billion ads. Long ads anytime you even attempt to do anything with the app, I’m good.

Worst ad model. I had the app for 5 minutes and had to delete it. It had the types of things I wanted to track, but I’m not sitting for 30 seconds to watch a stupid game every time I click to use each app function. And this is coming from someone who works in advertising! Total failure. I’m shocked anyone uses this app.
Ok. I like the app and the different information it gives you, but there are a lot of ads when you try to switch in between anything
Love the app. Just wish it didn't have so may ads and I even purchased it to pro
Too many adds. App was great before. Now every time you click on something you have to go through a stupid add. Will be looking for a better app

Ads ads ads. I used to like this app despite having features you had to pay to use - which I won’t pay for- Now they added in ads in the 2 main features I use. We are not talking quick ads. No they are more like a minute long. Unless the ads are removed I will be deleting this app.
Ads ruined this app. I love this app and it helped me a lot, but recently they added ads in and it ruined it for me. It’s way too much.

Adverts are really distracting. There used to not be ads when I used this months ago and I really appreciated the app. I started using it again and now there are ads - including for gambling sites. This is really distracting and not at all helpful.
Great app ruined by ads. I understand the need to get compensation for this work but, the ads are so long and often now that this is nearly unusable for me.

Favorite sobriety app... until the constant ads started!. My favorite app in recovery! It has so many things to track! This would have been a 5 star review but sadly, the most recent update now gives you constant ads every time you click on something. The ads are long, repetitive, and annoying. I've stopped using the app because it isn't worth the hassle and frustration anymore. Really bummed they changed it...

Good but now so many ads. I really like this app but it was better without all of the ads. I understand that’s how money is made but it’s hard when you open to excitedly check a stat and immediately have to watch a long ad or two. I would’ve just paid for the app! Is there an option to pay and go ad free?

Great app, but... I love this app, it’s awesome. Unfortunately I had to delete it because after eight days using it, it started popping up ads for other game apps that I didn’t want and wouldn’t let me exit out of them unless I clicked to install or exited the app, then it would pop up another, and another, and another. Unfortunately that made the app unusable. ☹️ I deleted it but will give it one more try. It will be a wonderful tool if I can use it without the unwanted app-ruining pop ups.

Great App. I love this app because it’s helped me continue on my path of sobriety. The only thing that kept me from giving it 5 stars is the look of the design. I feel like it’s a bit dated and could use an overhaul to be more appealing to the masses.

Very informative. This app is really cool. It not only tells you how many days, it showcases all of the different entities that substances impact your life. For example, (x) # days of not drinking is the equivalent caloric intake of running (y) # hours 😳Cool facts like that. You don’t have to pay for any of these extra things either, the only thing that’s “Pro” is like help and a diary. By far the best counter I’ve seen.
Helpful. It keeps me from not wanting to break my promise

9 months of help so far. This app is simple, it keeps track of sobriety and gives you steps along the way and markers of success. People need accountability for sobriety and if you apply yourself to this app and celebrate your own successes, you will enjoy this app. Remember, nothing feels like sobriety no matter how painful the course, this app shows you the benefits of that path.
Happy good night. The only ones that I need is the ones you have done done and your next year will really help me out and you have a smile

What a wonderful app!. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. 1,000x thank you. I am going through an incredibly ugly divorce after a very short-lived, abusive marriage and a couple weeks ago I found myself on a slippery slope regarding my alcohol consumption. This app has given me all of the metrics and reminders I need to stay 100% sober. I would recommend this app to absolutely anyone and everyone, no matter how ‘healthy’ they may think their level of consumption might be.

Eye Opening. This app helped me see exactly how much damage I had been doing to myself over the years, physically and financially. Great app, would recommend for anyone on my level of alcohol use to use.

Love it. I used this app years ago on my android and I always had the most success with it. The health section is the most motivating to me. I also really like the “beat an urge” game. I have been looking for it for at least 2 years on my iPhone… so maybe it’s new on this platform? I am ECSTATIC to find it again!

Very Helpful!. The app is pretty simple, but also very helpful and easy to use. I’m somewhat data driven and I found the Total Health, Timer, and Goals Achieved very motivating. I initially planned to take a 30 day break, now I’m on day 72 and counting. This tool combined with online stories of other people in similar situations, and the health benefits I’m seeing are working!

Positive and Cheerful. I’ve been looking for an app to support an alcohol free lifestyle that isn’t depressing or too preachy. I find this app cheerful and encouraging to use toward cutting back and/or quitting entirely. The health section is incredibly motivating for me.
Great app!. This app shows you how your health improves after you quit drinking. It helps to seethe actual progress everyday!

Easy to use. So far I am loving how easy this app is to use. It keeps track of how many days and hours I have been sober plus keeps a tally on how much money I am saving!! I love the option to allow myself so many drinks a week if I want as well.

Great encouragement. This is the only app that shows how you are doing physically after so many days, months, years w/out alcohol. Knowing where I am physically and financially is the best motivating I’ve seen in a sobriety app.
Ads ads ads. Unusable due to immediate ads for trash games that you can’t close. Two within five seconds of opening the app.
Constant Adverts. Unusable due to the ads popping up constantly

Fantastic app. Only only one downside. I’ve used this app on and off for a few years now. It’s great for tracking your drinking. Weight and even gives a timeline for how your heath is improving. However if for any reason you loose the app buy a new phone etc. your loose all of your dater. There is no way of saving your account. However you can enter this manually if you remember the date you quit. This has a free version without being bombshelled with adds as well as a payed version. Both fantastic
Too many ads. I really like this app but lately the adverts have been too much.
Full of adverts. Adverts every moment - rubbish, exploitative
Stopping alcohol. This seems to keep me on my toes even though it’s early days and I’m not getting carried away
Ads are a nightmare!. Agree with other reviewers, used to be a good app now constant ads which you cannot get rid of! Will be deleting unfortunately.
great app. really nice app, useful information fun game ! free too

Gone down hill. This use to be an amazing app to keep you on track and go to remind your self of the days and how far you have come but now they have adverts so you have to keep going out of the app to go on what you want to look at spoils it so now I don't use it

Not appropriate. The app itself is pretty good. I think it’s a good tool to quit drinking. 

What I find totally inappropriate are all the ads for gambling apps. This app is designed for people with addiction problems and pushing gambling at them is a low blow 

It’s a bit like “ hey saved fifty bucks on beer why not spend it on roulette.” 

It would be funny if it wasn’t so dangerous to vulnerable people.
Ads have ruined it. Used to be my favourite sober app but now there are so many ads it’s ridiculous. Such a shame.
Too many ads. I wouldn’t mind but they refuse to come off screen!!
Ads ads ads. Really loved this app but since I started using it again a couple of days ago it’s absolutely impossible to use because of the number of ads. Every tap seems to bring up another one.
Gambling ads??. Enjoyed this app until it starting advertising slot apps… not ideal for people who already have addictions!!
Great app!. Funky design and has everything i need

Wow, just what I was looking for!!. I’ve just packed in the booze and this app is absolutely brilliant and trust me I can be a moody sod and hard to please at the best of times, however this app is really brilliantly laid out, easy to navigate, loads of good information everywhere you look, I could go on and on and end up boring my self, but if you have had enough of drinking to excess or you just want to lay off the booze for a good while like me then give this app a try, you won’t be disappointed!
Helps to boost mood. Really good little app, shows how many calories that have been saved. This is great if your trying to lose weight!
Relapse. It’s ok. Can’t figure out how to reset if I relapse.

Faulty App. Literally didn’t work, as in the app didn’t track any time since I entered the date for the last drink. 
A shame because I liked the look of the features. Tried deleting and reinstalling several times but still no luck.
Great app.. I tried a few before this one. I love the simplicity, the awards and the game which can be played when a craving creeps up. Brilliant 🙌

This app has literally made it possible to live age.. Apps promise so much these days and it is rare to find one that delivers. I have been using this now for five months and it’s like a friend who pays me on the back each and every day, then throws me a virtual party when I hit a milestone. Addiction recovery is hard and this app is not a cure all, but it allows to to track your progress. It does not preach or complain if you get things wrong, it is there for you everyday.
Great. Very handy app thanks!
Ads suck. The ads are horrible I love this app it's the only one like it out there but the ads.... find a way to make them be gone. I’ll literally pay for the app if it means there's no ads
Scammy ads now. I get ads saying I am being hacked or my account is hacked. Just uninstall as it facilitates malicious agents now.
It worked for me. I’ve now been alcohol free for over three years. This app really helped me out and I still come back to it to check my stats. I’ve recommended it to tons of people.
Ads frequency is ridiculous. I cant input anything without ads taking over the screen repeatedly.. The ads so

Do not use. This app was great until pop up ads every time you open the app
You need to wait and watch the ads then cancel the add, only to be shown another one
Sometimes the “x” to close the adds ( usually for app games) doesn’t show up and you need to close the app and start again
Horrible. Frustrating
Don’t bother. I used to love this app but now there’s ads blocking me from using the app. It’s totally unusable !

Was ok until. I thought that this was a really cool app. When I first downloaded it, the information was so helpful. Now a couple of months later, this app is near impossible to use. Literally every time you tap to use a single function, you have to sit through a 30 second ad. I don’t mind the occasional ad, but these ads are now so frequent that the app is now useless to me. Really a shame.
Ads make it unusable. I used to love it . Now it’s ridiculous and not worth bothering because of the ads. I’ve tried other apps , but not quite as good as this one. I would pay for it if no ads

Impossible à regarder. La version gratuite est pleine de publicités ce qui rend très difficile l’accès à l’application. Je ne la recommande pas et je n’ai aucune envie de l’acheter car je n’ai pas pu l’utiliser adéquatement avec toute cette publicité

Good app, but currently not working due to excessive ads. The ads recently have made it completely unusable. I just watched 15 ads and STILL wasn’t able to update my data! I don’t know if it’s a glitch, but I had been recommending this app to others and now I want to DELETE and publicly shame these money grabbing folk for not even providing a basic app service and WASTING time! Fix this please! Sigh 🙄
Супер. Отличное приложение, которое помогает отслеживать дни трезвости и справиться с зависимостью

AD’s... Here’s an app that is supposed to help towards curing an addiction and there’s all kinds of gambling ads??? This APP is a complete waste of time. Used to actually be a good ad. Pass on it GARBAGE
Too many ads. The amount of ads is far too much, it’s ruined the app.

Total spam. This app is barely useable. Hubby and I decided to do Dry January for fun and thought a gamified experience would be interesting. Gamified indeed. 

Every thing you click in this app launches the longest video ads everywhere. Every single thing. There are many other alternatives that don't spam you to death. Deleting this app.
Used to be a good app. Now you can’t click anything without watching an ad. Also… why the heck would you allow ads for gambling on an addiction app? Disgusting. Predatory app creators.

Ads blocking every page. Ads are now riddled all over this, can’t even check settings without watching an ad. I’d pay a few bucks to support the dev instead of this nonsense but I can’t find anywhere to “buy“ in
J’aime. Ça
J’aime beaucoup mais. Un endroit pour écrire nos consommations de la journée pour faire un meilleur suivi ça serait super

Améliorations possibles. Certains textes semblent mal traduits 
Certaines fonctions difficiles à trouver, par exemple le nombre de verres refusés. 
Ajouter ses informations en passant par paramètres n’est pas si évident à trouver non plus. Peut être l’ajouter en haut dans une section « profil » ? 

Les infos santés sont très intéressantes et motivantes, merci !

Pratique. Application. Simple pratique et visuel. Bon outil pour débuter un arrêt de consommation d’alcool.

Merci

Great app. I’m loving using this app. I highly recommend it if you’re going to stop drinking. I’m at one month and doing really well. I love all the features. You can set a reward with all the money you save - I’m getting a robot vacuum. Lol. A treat for all my hard work.

Great tool to keep track of sobriety. I like how you see the progress you’ve made. It’s user friendly and great visuals. You can see your progress and it’s super motivating. Tried a few sobriety apps and this is the best one by far.

Not free anymore. This app was great when it was free because there was more to it than other apps, you could track cravings and keep notes but those features are no longer available in the free version.
Énorme !. Une application conviviale et ô combien utile pour ma démarche ! Merci !
Parfaite!. Pour les avoir toutes essayées, celle-ci est la plus complète et la plus motivante! 3 mois aujourd’hui sans une goutte. Merci
Great app. Love this app really easy to use, quick to see your count. But don’t like the addition of adds, it’s frustrating.
Used to be good. App used to be really good and motivating. Now it’s hardly usable with all the ads that you can’t get out of.
Takes me to unwanted links to games. What has happened to this app?
Admania!. Can’t get to any part of the app at the moment. It’s an endless loop of adverts for ADDICTIVE games. Bad form. App now useless.

Gambling ads aren’t helping on an addiction app. What happened to this app? I used to love it to monitor my sobriety and now all it is is ads that are impossible to close. I keep getting hit with online slot/poker machine ads and it just makes me want to head to a bar and gamble. Will need to delete this app soon I think.
Advertising is painful. The ads are impossible to close. Makes for a really annoying experience
LOVE. I’ve tried all the sober, stop drinking apps and this IS THE BEST!
Helpful but needs more instructions. Very helpful app but please explain the current flips page. There is no guidance.

So motivating. This app has been a game changer! 
It makes it so clear all the benefits you get from reducing alcohol and a timeframe (which I need).
I just really wish that if you do have a drink you have the option to not complete start back at the start as progress is still progress!
Easy 5 stars. Adds some fun to a tough situation. The best a craving game is great and it’s motivating to see the stats

Very ugly but hugely functional. To think that I was put off by the way this app looks. The information it gives is great. Saving money is a great incentive, but mental and physical health targets speak more to me!
If someone made the interface prettier it would be absolutely killer.

A good app ruined with ads. Good trackers and health information but the ads on the free version make this app pretty much unusable. Embedding interactive ads where you have to click on “get” to be redirected to the App Store for some pointless mobile game without any option to close the ad after a time period.
One week sober. I like this app... very helpful

Great Sobriety App. Really simple and easy to use. No motivation quotes or AA jargon. Loved the facts that you can scroll through as well as helpful tips if you want them. The distraction game was a hit for me too. 5 stars.
